subject: Shiny Server on Port 3838 - Connection times out

messages.author: 062874f477d67759
messages.subject: Shiny Server on Port 3838 - Connection times out
parts:
Hi all,

My connection keeps timing out when I try to connect to my Shiny App using a static IP address.  

I am configuring my Shiny Server on a Linux (CentOS 6.7) Virtual Machine with a Windows 7 host.  I have set up a bridged network between the host and the guest and I have a static IP address for the guest.  

 - I can ping the guest IP from the host.
 - I can ping the host IP from the guest.
 - I can ping the guest IP from another computer on the network.
 - I can ping the host IP from another computer on the network.

When I try localhost:3838/ the sample app loads perfectly.

However, when I try the <Static_IP_Address>:3838/, the connection times out.

If I can access the app using localhost:3838/, does that mean the port is open?  Or could this port be closed regardless of whether I can connect to localhost:3838/ or not?  

Any ideas on what I can try?

Thanks!

Nick

messages.author: 062874f477d67759
messages.subject: Re: Shiny Server on Port 3838 - Connection times out
parts:
For posterity purposes, I solved my problem by:
1) Disabling iptables in the guest VM
2) I changed the listening port from 3838 to Port 8080.
